description: The restructured reference with the release-check outcome requirement (PASS/FAIL summary and exit status) removed, and quality degraded: vague untestable scenarios, decisions without rationale, a design registry that disagrees with the specified manifest, and a test plan that drops capture, failure-path, and viewer tests.

quality_defects.where: specs/scene-runtime (Window resize), specs/viewer-controls (Present mode keeps attention on the diagram), specs/presentation-authoring (Composition flags are resolved)
quality_defects.defect: THEN clauses read "continues to look right", "feels focused and uncluttered", and "makes the layout acceptable". The requirement text still carries each commitment, so coverage is unchanged.
The design registers presentations in `src/registry.ts` while the specification requires a hand-edited `src/presentations.json` manifest.
All twelve decisions are bare labels with no reason and no alternatives.
IC-3, RC-2, and AR-3 are removed, and the plan no longer assigns viewer input or cleanup to unit tests: Viewing modes, Moving between steps, Sequence ends, and Cleanup have no planned check.

notes: Borderline: INV-093. The render pass still "fails" and names the step, and a missing sample still fails with a message, but nothing commits to an overall pass/fail outcome or exit status; the expected verdict is missing.
